steps.title: Cloudy lens / moisture
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Yellow haze is often UV clearcoat failure. Internal fogging after rain often means a failed seal or vent. Education only — aggressive polishing can thin the lens.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Haze vs water inside
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: External haze: restoration kits may help temporarily. Water droplets inside on the reflector: reseal/replace path — do not run high beams hoping it 'burns off' as a fix. If the lamp is cracked, prefer replacement.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Moisture / seal education
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Check dust caps, vents, and cracks. Dry only if you can open designed access — never drill random holes. Persistent moisture → assembly seal failure; shop or assembly path.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Polish education (optional)
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: If you polish: shade, wet sand only as kit instructs, UV seal afterward. Stop if you see through thin spots. Results vary; this is not a permanent OEM clearcoat.
steps.safety_warning: Chemical splash risk — gloves and eye protection. Do not polish while lamps are hot.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Re-check at night
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Confirm beam is not scattered into oncoming lanes. If glare is worse after polish or LED bulb hacks, stop using that setup and revisit housing design / local rules.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.
